VALUE CONTRADICTION FLAG. GEM SegmentCost=46,000,000 USD. The awarded EWPS-1-Shedgum EPC contract (Gas Arabian Services, signed 29 May 2024) is SAR 344,614,412 = ~92 million USD (Zawya, and Argaam: 'nearly SAR 344.6 million, excluding VAT', 40 months, 2024-2027 impact). The GEM row is only pipeline '3' (EWPS-1-Shedgum "3"), so the 46,000,000 USD appears to be a GEM half-split of the ~92M USD contract across pipelines 3 and 4. No source states 46M for a single pipeline; the sources support ~92M USD / SAR 344.6M for the combined 3+4 package. Refs support the parent contract value; the exact 46M half is a GEM derivation. Recommend verifying whether the segment cost should instead be the full ~92M USD (SAR 344.6M) or remain the half-split, and whether pipeline 4 is a separate GEM row.
